name: quarterly_report_detection
query: Create a quarterly report for Q4 2024
expected_behavior: Detects quarterly report type from 'Q4 2024' pattern
Calculates correct date range (October 1 - December 31, 2024)
Fetches data with both QoQ (prior_period) and YoY (prior_year) comparisons
Generates PDF with 10-18 pages as per quarterly spec
Includes 15 top keywords as per quarterly limit

name: monthly_pptx_format
query: Generate October 2024 monthly report as PowerPoint
expected_behavior: Detects monthly report type from 'October 2024' pattern
Generates PPTX format (not PDF)
Includes MoM comparisons (prior_period)
Creates 16:9 aspect ratio slides
Applies PinMeTo brand colors

name: yearly_report_format
query: Generate 2024 annual report for all locations
expected_behavior: Detects yearly report type from '2024' and 'annual' keywords
Calculates full year date range (January 1 - December 31, 2024)
Fetches data with YoY comparison only
Generates PDF with 15-25 pages as per yearly spec
Includes 25 top keywords as per yearly limit

name: half_yearly_detection
expected_behavior: Detects half-yearly report type from 'H1' pattern
Calculates correct date range (January 1 - June 30, 2024)
Includes HoH comparisons
Generates executive summary with highlights and KPIs

name: single_location_report
query: Generate Q3 2024 report for Store #47 only
expected_behavior: Detects quarterly report type
Filters data to specific store_id
Passes store_id parameter to all MCP tool calls
Report focuses on single location metrics

name: google_data_lag_warning
query: Create a monthly report for last week's data
expected_behavior: Warns user about Google's ~10-day data lag
Suggests adjusting end date to at least 10 days ago
Does not proceed with report until user confirms adjusted dates

name: validation_before_generation
query: Generate a quarterly report from the fetched data
expected_behavior: Runs validate_report_data.py before generating PDF/PPTX
Reports any validation errors found
Fixes validation errors before proceeding
